title: Pasta with sauce, meatless, school lunch

content.title: About
content.content: Meat‑less pasta with sauce is a ready‑to‑serve school lunch. The pasta, made from durum wheat, is tossed in a tomato‑based sauce enriched with vegetable purées and contains no meat. The dish provides a balanced mix of carbohydrates, vitamins and minerals suitable for school‑age children.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Durum wheat pasta contains more protein and fiber than regular pasta.
Meat‑less tomato sauce is often fortified with vitamin C and lycopene, which improve iron absorption from plant sources.
The product complies with national school nutrition standards, including limits on salt and fat.
Unopened packages can be stored at room temperature for up to 12 months.
Small pieces of carrot, zucchini and sweet pepper are often added to boost nutritional value.

items.title: Energy supply
items.content: Carbohydrates from the pasta provide sustained energy and help children stay full throughout the school day.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Durum wheat is a good source of B1, B2 and niacin, which support metabolism and nervous‑system function.

items.title: Lycopene and vitamin C
items.content: The tomato sauce offers antioxidant protection, supporting immunity and protecting cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Vegetable additions increase fiber content, promoting healthy digestion.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: The absence of meat and limited added oils make the dish suitable for reducing cardiovascular risk.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: Durum wheat pasta contains gluten, which can trigger reactions in individuals with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Salt content
items.content: Salt is limited to meet school guidelines, but consumers should still check the label for exact amounts.

items.title: Heat treatment
items.content: The meal should be heated to at least 75 °C to ensure any potential bacteria are destroyed.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the portion in a microwave or steam oven until piping hot, then stir to distribute the sauce evenly. Optionally sprinkle a small amount of grated cheese or fresh herbs before serving.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated at +4 °C and consume within 3‑4 days.
